data.name: WelcomeText
data.value: Welcome to Gillian's GTA IV Setup Utility!

data.name: TipsNote
data.value: Keep the options at default values unless you know what you're doing.

data.name: GuideLink
data.value: Visit my Guide for more info and optimal graphics settings

data.name: DirectoryLabelUnselected
data.value: Set your game directory before using:

data.name: InstallDXVKPromptDescription
data.value: Your iGPU supports DXVK but your GPU doesn't - do you still wish to install DXVK?

data.name: WhichDXVKPromptDescription
data.value:
Your iGPU supports a greater version of DXVK than your GPU - which version do you wish to install?

Press 'Yes' to install the version matching your GPU.

Press 'No' to install the version matching your iGPU instead.

data.name: InteliGPUDXVKPromptDescription
data.value: Your PC only has an Intel iGPU on it. While it does support more modern versions on paper, it's reported that DXVK 1.10.1 might be your only supported version. Do you wish to install it?\n\nIf 'No' is selected, DXVK will be installed following the normal procedure.

data.name: AsyncTipDescription
data.value: DXVK-async is the next best alternative to stutter-less experience - since your GPU doesn't support GPL with Fast Linking, you can reduce stutter with async shader building, which will be a little faster than traditional shader building.

data.name: VSyncTipDescription
data.value: The in-game VSync implementation produces framepacing issues. DXVK's VSync implementation should be preferred.\n\nIt's recommended to keep this on and in-game's implementation off.

data.name: LatencyTipDescription
data.value: This option may help avoiding further framepacing issues. It's recommended to keep this on.

data.name: NoRestrictionsTipDescription
data.value: This option allows you to set any in-game settings independently of what the game restricts you to. It's recommended to keep this on.

data.name: NoMemRestrictTipDescription
data.value: This option allows the game to use all the dedicated memory resources up to the limits. It's recommended to keep this on.

data.name: AvailableVidMemTipDescription
data.value: This option forces a specific value of video memory due to the game not being able to do so automatically sometimes. It's recommended to keep this at default.

data.name: AvailableVidMemLockTipDescription
data.value:
This option allows to change between a 3GB and a 4GB VRAM lock when setting -availablevidmem up.

The game is 32-bit, so going beyond 4GB is entirely pointless. However, some people reported less issues with it being locked to 3GB instead.

It's recommended to keep this at default. Option is disabled if latest FusionFix is detected.

data.name: WindowedTipDescription
data.value: This option allows to use Borderless Fullscreen instead of Exclusive Fullscreen. Provides better experience and sometimes better performance. It's recommended to keep this on.

data.name: MonitorDetailsTipDescription
data.value: This option forces a specific resolution and refresh rate due to the game not being able to do so automatically sometimes. It's recommended to keep this at default.

data.name: AboutIntroText
data.value: This software is made by Gillian for the GTA IV Modding Guide. Below is internal information text which may be useful for debugging.

data.name: SteamVersionNoticeDescription
data.value: You appear to have a commandline.txt, however you are using the Steam/RGL version which doesn't use that file.\n\nConsider moving these options to Steam Launch Options or launch arguments.

data.name: DXVKInstalledDescription
data.value:
{0} has been installed!

Consider going to Steam - Settings - Downloads and disable `Enable Shader Pre-caching` - this may improve your performance.

Additionally, you can enable ReBAR and force it for the game - that may, too, improve performance.

data.name: VulkanInfoCheckFullFailDescription
data.value: The Vulkan check failed entirely. This usually means none of your GPUs support Vulkan. Make sure your drivers are up-to-date - don't rely on Windows Update drivers, either.\n\nDXVK is not available.

data.name: NotificationsDescription
data.value: \n\nMake sure your drivers are up-to-date - don't rely on Windows Update drivers, either.

data.name: VulkanInfoFailPartial
data.value: The Vulkan check failed partially. This usually means one of your GPUs may support Vulkan but has outdated drivers - the tool will proceed assuming so, but installing DXVK is not recommended.

data.name: VulkanInfoCheckFailDGPU
data.value: The Vulkan check failed for the discrete GPU but succeeded for the integrated GPU. This usually means your discrete GPU does not support Vulkan.\n\nDXVK is available, but with the assumption that you're going to be playing off the integrated GPU, not the dedicated one.

data.name: VulkanInfoCheckOneGPUFail
data.value: The Vulkan check failed for one of the GPUs but succeeded for the rest. This usually means one of your discrete GPUs does not support Vulkan.\n\nDXVK is available, but with the assumption that you're going to be playing off the supported GPU.

data.name: VulkanInfoOneGPLFail
data.value: The GPL check failed for one of the GPUs but Fast Linking is supported by at least one of them. This usually means one of your discrete GPUs or the iGPU does not support DXVK in full.\n\nThe tool will proceed with the assumption that you're going to be playing off the GPU that didn't fail the GPL check (usually your main GPU), but provide options for async just incase.

data.name: FusionFixOutdatedDescription
data.value: Please note that your FusionFix is outdated. It is highly recommended to update the mod for access to latest stability improvements, fixes and graphical improvements\n\nPress "Yes" to be redirected to the download page for FusionFix.

data.name: ASILoaderOutdatedDescription
data.value: You appear to have an outdated ASI Loader (dsound.dll). It's highly recommended to update it for best mod compatibility.\n\nDelete dsound.dll and press 'Yes' to get redirected to download the latest version - download the non-x64 one, rename dinput8.dll to xlive.dll if you are using a downgraded version and don't plan to play GFWL.

data.name: RTSSConflictDescription
data.value:
You currently have RivaTuner Statistics Server enabled (it might be a part of MSI Afterburner).

To avoid issues with the game launching when DXVK and IVSDK .NET are both installed, go into your tray icons, press on the little monitor icon with the number 60, press 'Add' in bottom left, select GTA IV's executable and set Application detection level to 'None'.

If you want the statistics, set it to Low and restart the tool, with the game running.

data.name: ZPatchOutdatedDescription
data.value: Your ZolikaPatch is outdated.\n\nDo you wish to download the latest version? (this will redirect to Zolika1351's website for manual download)

data.name: ZPatchOutdatedDescription2
data.value: Press OK to restart the app after updating ZolikaPatch. Do not unpack 'PlayGTAIV.exe'.

data.name: GFWLAchievementsDescription
data.value: You appear to be using GFWL. Do you wish to remove Steam Achievements (if exists) and fix {0} options to receive GFWL achievements?\n\nPressing 'No' can revert this if you agreed to this earlier.

data.name: GFWLAchievementsDescriptionOpenPreCE
data.value: You appear to be using GFWL. Do you wish to fix OpenPreCEPatch options to receive GFWL achievements?\n\nSteam Achievements stay enabled and keep working alongside them. Pressing 'No' can revert this if you agreed to this earlier.

data.name: ZPatchCompatibilityDescription
data.value: Your {0} options are incompatible with FusionFix. This may lead to crashes, inconsistencies, visual issues etc.\n\nDo you wish to fix the options?

data.name: VRAMManualDescription
data.value: Could not detect VRAM automatically.\n\nPlease enter your VRAM (in MB):

data.name: LinuxDetectedDescription
data.value: DXVK installation and Vulkan checking is only available on Windows.\n\nThese features have been disabled. Launch options configuration remains available.

data.name: DlssIvEnableTip
data.value: Turns the DLSS-IV upscaler on or off by renaming DLSS-IV.asi to .disabled. HDR and performance features only run while it is enabled. FusionFix anti-aliasing is switched off while DLSS-IV is active.

data.name: DlssIvHdrTip
data.value: Your monitor must support HDR, and HDR must be enabled in Windows settings before the game starts. You can fine-tune HDR peak, paper white and roll-off in DLSS-IV.cfg.

data.name: DlssIvStatusMissing
data.value: DLSS-IV.asi / DLSS-IV.cfg / DLSSIV was not found in the game folder.

data.name: DlssIvRequiresDxvk
data.value: DLSS-IV requires the latest DXVK support (detected: {0}).

data.name: DlssIvFusionFixMissing
data.value: FusionFix was not detected. DLSS-IV requires FusionFix with the Vulkan graphics API, so the mod has been disabled.

data.name: DlssIvNoUpscaling
data.value: This GPU does not support any DLSS-IV upscaler. The mod can still be enabled for its performance features; upscaler settings remain disabled.

data.name: DlssIvConfirmUpdateDlssDescription
data.value: This downloads about {0} from NVIDIA's DLSS SDK repository and replaces DLSSIV\nvngx_dlss.dll. The old file is backed up.

data.name: DlssIvConfirmUpdateFsrDescription
data.value: This downloads only the two signed DLLs (about {0}) from AMD's FSR SDK repository and replaces DLSSIV\amd_fidelityfx_upscaler_dx12.dll plus its loader. The old files are backed up.

data.name: DlssIvDescription
data.value: DLSS-IV adds native DLSS, FSR and HDR to GTA IV.

data.name: DlssIvAutoDisabledDescription
data.value: Your GPU does not support the latest DXVK (detected: {0}). DLSS-IV requires the latest DXVK runtime, so it has been turned off automatically. Update your graphics driver (and don't rely on Windows Update drivers), then enable DLSS-IV again.

data.name: DlssIvFsr4LiteTip
data.value: FSR 4 Lite is selected natively by AMD on Ryzen AI / Radeon 7xxM-8xxM APUs. Other GPUs do not offer it, because the community INT8 fork is RDNA2-specific and freezes elsewhere.

data.name: DxvkAlreadyLatestTitle
data.value: DXVK is already up to date

data.name: DxvkAlreadyLatestDescription
data.value: DXVK {0} is already installed in the game folder. The tool will not download it again.

data.name: DlssIvConfirmFsr4Description
data.value: This downloads the fsr4xyz RDNA2 INT8 FSR 4 build (about {0}) and replaces only DLSSIV\amd_fidelityfx_upscaler_dx12.dll. It is offered only for RDNA2 cards.

data.name: DlssIvFsr4UpToDate
data.value: Community FSR 4 is already up to date ({0}).

data.name: DlssIvFsr4Unsupported
data.value: This GPU is not supported by the community FSR 4 build. Use DLSS or FSR 3.1.
